title: Emmy Noether: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Working Drafts
description:
Dedicated Emmy Noether record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This version keeps the curated reader-facing working surface and adds RA33, a Paper 02 Tabelle II top-band source-audit packet following the RA31 Tabelle I audit package.

Current reader files. The main cumulative readers and standalone English paper PDFs remain the reader-facing surface. RA25-RA33 are correction/audit tranches for the German/source branch of Paper 02, not full multilingual propagation packages.

Latest correction package. Adds N_SYM_RA33_P02_tableII_top_20260612.zip and Noether_RA33_Public_Status_20260613.md. RA33 source-checks Paper 02 Tabelle II on printed/source p.92, top band rows 0-7, against high-DPI source images and corrects the German/source cumulative branch. The package includes source slices, render checks, CSV ledgers, audit PDF, and a table-cell correction ledger.

Status at a glance. This is not a certified critical edition. The files are useful working drafts, translation drafts, and source-audit correction packets; subtle formula errors, scan-reading errors, apparatus drift, and cross-language synchronization errors may remain. Verify important equations, tables, theorem statements, and unusual notation against the source witnesses before citation-critical use.

Known open items. Paper 02 body pp.23-90 is closed at the RA29/RA30 page-level standard, Tabelle I p.91 is source-checked at RA31, and Tabelle II p.92 rows 0-7 are source-checked at RA33. Tabelle II rows 8-23 remain open using source p.92 slices 2-3. A final Paper 02 equation-tag/display-layout inventory and non-German propagation to EN/ES/JA/FR/ZH remain queued until the table plates close. Full symbol-level source audit remains open beyond Paper 01 and the current Paper 02 tranches.

Corrections and collaboration. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through GitHub issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
